title: Kragsmash
summary: Kragsmash calls strength and speed adds at three health thresholds.
overview: Kragsmash calls strength and speed adds at three health thresholds.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: The eligible monk starts the challenge through dialogue.
At 75%, 50% and 25%, collect the paired strength and speed adds.
Keep enough damage and healing available to finish inside the thirty-minute combat window.
